name: Immich
description: Photos, videos and Immich's own database dumps.

extra_mounts.label: External library
extra_mounts.description: Photos and videos Immich reads from a folder you added as an external library. Immich only indexes them; they are not in its own folder.

folders.label: Uploads
folders.description: Your photos and videos as uploaded. This is where Immich keeps originals unless the storage template is on.

folders.label: Library
folders.description: Your photos and videos, when Immich's storage template is on.

folders.label: Profile pictures
folders.description: Pictures users set for their accounts.

folders.label: Database dumps
folders.description: Immich's nightly copy of its database: albums, people, faces, descriptions and settings.

folders.label: Previews
folders.description: Thumbnails and preview images. Immich rebuilds them after a restore.

folders.label: Re-encoded videos
folders.description: Smaller copies of your videos for streaming. Immich rebuilds them after a restore.

pre_backup_script.name: Check Immich database dump
pre_backup_script.description: Stop the backup if Immich has not written a database dump in the last 26 hours.

notes: Keep Administration > Settings > Backup turned on in Immich. This backup relies on Immich's own daily database dumps in the backups folder.
After a restore with previews or re-encoded videos skipped, run the Generate Thumbnails and Transcode Videos jobs in Immich.
